import os, signal, subprocess, time
out=subprocess.run(['ps','-ef'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
print(out[:2000])
for line in out.splitlines():
    if any(x in line for x in ['TopicTree_bug','uwsbugbuild','g++ -std=c++17','git worktree add']) and 'grep' not in line:
        pid=int(line.split()[1]); print('killing',pid,line); os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
print('done')
